//: Inputs of `pnpm --filter @emojisense/eval cost` and the eval report. Edit freely. Prices: docs/RESEARCH.md (checked 2026-10-02). Keys named // are comments.
//deviceShare: L0: share of searches the on-device dictionary answers with confidence, so no semantic request is made. With useMeasuredDeviceShare, the eval's measured rate (reports/latest.json) replaces it. The eval set over-represents hard queries, so the measured share is pessimistic.
//requestsPerSemanticSearch: Debounced requests per search that needs semantic results (a pause while typing sends a request for a prefix).
//shardHitShare: L2: share of those semantic requests answered by a shard: the live layer (real queries) or the base layer (synthetic phrases). Shards come from the CDN host: a cache hit runs no Worker and costs nothing; R2 reads on CDN misses are not counted (10M free per month, then $0.36 / 1M). Clients that read shards on the API host's /p/ route pay a Worker request each, not counted here.
//cacheHitRate: L3: Cache API hit rate of the requests that still reach the Worker. Low, because L2 already takes the frequent queries; what is left is the long tail.

model.//: id null = the production model in packages/data/pack.config.json. pricePerMTokens null = the listed Workers AI price; a model without a listed price (EmbeddingGemma) uses assumedPricePerMTokens and is flagged.

reactions.//: POST /v1/suggest-reactions. Calls per search, input ≤ 256 chars ≈ 64 tokens. Never cached (chat text).

images.//: POST /v1/classify-image. gemma-4-26b-a4b-it reads a 384 px image (≈ 800 input tokens at $0.10 / 1M) and writes a short caption (≈ 50 tokens at $0.30 / 1M): ≈ $0.0001 per image (DECISIONS.md). The perceptual-hash cache skips the model for repeated memes; the caption then goes through text search (tokensPerImage).

analyticsEngine.//: One data point per Worker request. Billing has not started. ⚠ pricePerMWrites is Cloudflare's announced rate, not verified in RESEARCH.md.

workersLogs.//: Workers Logs: src/analytics.ts writes one structured line per API request (production keeps logs, without URLs). 20M lines a month included in Workers Paid, then $0.60 / 1M.

d1.//: D1 rows written per search request: its app's query_daily count (src/query-stats.ts). Since migration 0009 the table is its key (WITHOUT ROWID, no index): a new row or an update is one written row, and a query repeated within an isolate's 10 s flush adds nothing more. So at most 1 per request: right for the long tail, high for the head. 50M rows a month included, then $1.00 / 1M.

sensitivity.//: Low and high values for the one-at-a-time sensitivity table.
